title: SmartBloch-Agent: An Agentic Framework for Automated MRI Sequence Design and Optimization
title_zh: SmartBloch-Agent：一个用于MRI序列自动化设计与优化的智能体框架

paragraphs.en: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) pulse sequences organize radiofrequency excitation, gradient encoding, and signal acquisition, determining magnetization evolution and image formation. Sequence research requires translating imaging objectives into executable protocols meeting physical and acquisition constraints, refined via physical simulation, signal reconstruction, and scientific evaluation. Sequence construction, physical verification, parameter search, and assessment involve many tools and manual decisions, limiting automation from objective to verifiable sequence. We develop SmartBloch-Agent, an integrated framework for automated MRI sequence design and optimization. Given objectives and scientific constraints in natural language, an AI agent interprets goals, plans tasks, orchestrates tools, and makes feedback-informed decisions, drawing on a construction module and optimizers for structural design and parameter search. Our GPU-accelerated SmartBloch engine supplies physical computation for both stages, so the framework configures, per sequence and objective, event validation, Full-Bloch magnetization evolution, signal acquisition, image reconstruction, and scientific evaluation, and closes the loop without external MRI simulators. Results return to the agent to guide sequence revision, parameter optimization, and candidate selection, and the design files carry simulation, reconstruction, and evaluation evidence, forming an output package for a real-scanner workflow. Experiments show the framework automatically designs and optimizes MRI sequences for varied objectives and constraints, refines candidates with physical feedback, and improves several parameter-estimation metrics and downstream quantitative reconstruction. SmartBloch-Agent unifies objectives, design, physical execution, and evaluation into a continuous workflow for end-to-end automation of MRI sequence research.
paragraphs.zh: 磁共振成像（MRI）脉冲序列组织射频激励、梯度编码与信号采集，决定磁化演化与图像形成。 序列研究需要将成像目标转化为满足物理与采集约束的可执行方案，并通过物理仿真、信号重建与科学评估加以完善。 序列构建、物理验证、参数搜索与评估涉及大量工具和人工决策，限制了从目标到可验证序列的自动化。 我们开发了 SmartBloch-Agent，一个用于 MRI 序列自动化设计与优化的集成框架。 给定自然语言描述的目标与科学约束，智能体解读目标、规划任务、调度工具并做出基于反馈的决策，依托构建模块与优化器完成结构设计与参数搜索。 我们的 GPU 加速 SmartBloch 引擎为两个阶段提供物理计算，因此该框架可针对每个序列和目标配置事件校验、Full-Bloch 磁化演化、信号采集、图像重建与科学评估，并无需外部 MRI 仿真器即可形成闭环。 结果返回给智能体以指导序列修改、参数优化与候选选择，设计文件中携带仿真、重建与评估证据，形成面向真实扫描仪工作流程的输出包。 实验表明，该框架能够针对多样化目标与约束自动设计与优化 MRI 序列，利用物理反馈完善候选序列，并提升多项参数估计指标与下游定量重建性能。 SmartBloch-Agent 将目标、设计、物理执行与评估统一为连续工作流程，实现 MRI 序列研究的端到端自动化。

paragraphs.en: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) uses radiofrequency (RF) excitation, gradient fields, and signal acquisition to measure tissue structure and physical properties noninvasively. Pulse sequences define the temporal organization and execution of these events. Sequence design directly affects image contrast, spatial resolution, acquisition efficiency, and quantitative information, making sequence research an important driver of advances in MRI. Bloch’s 1946 description of nuclear magnetization dynamics provided a physical foundation for predicting magnetization evolution [ 1 ] . In 1973, Lauterbur demonstrated spatial magnetic resonance imaging with spatially varying magnetic fields [ 2 ] . Controlling magnetization and acquiring its resulting signals subsequently became central problems in sequence research.

paragraphs.en: As MRI evolved from basic imaging toward rapid acquisition and complex encoding, sequence research expanded the range of possible measurements. Small-flip-angle rapid imaging methods developed in the 1980s enabled acquisitions with short repetition times [ 3 ] . In the late 1990s, parallel imaging further improved acquisition efficiency by exploiting the spatial sensitivities of multiple receiver coils [ 4 ] . These advances arose not only from hardware improvements but also from coordinated developments in excitation, echo formation, spatial encoding, and reconstruction. Researchers increasingly had to manage complex event timing, hardware limits, magnetization responses, and image reconstruction. Sequence research thus evolved from constructing individual pulse protocols into an integrated activity involving physical modeling, computation, and system implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 随着磁共振成像从基础成像向快速采集和复杂编码演进，序列研究扩展了可能的测量范围。 20世纪80年代发展起来的小翻转角快速成像方法使得短重复时间采集成为可能 [ 3 ] 。 20世纪90年代末，并行成像通过利用多个接收线圈的空间敏感性进一步提高了采集效率 [ 4 ] 。 这些进展不仅源于硬件改进，也源于激发、回波形成、空间编码和重建方面的协同发展。 研究人员日益需要管理复杂的事件时序、硬件限制、磁化响应和图像重建。 因此，序列研究从构建单个脉冲方案演变为涉及物理建模、计算和系统实现的综合性活动。

paragraphs.en: This study addresses two related tasks in MRI sequence research: sequence design and sequence optimization . Sequence design establishes or modifies the organization of RF, gradient, timing, and readout events for a specified imaging objective and converts the resulting protocol into an executable sequence. Sequence optimization searches a defined space of parameters or waveforms under physical constraints to improve contrast, acquisition efficiency, signal characteristics, or quantitative performance. Design determines which measurement mechanisms and sequence structures can be explored, whereas optimization identifies suitable operating conditions. Although these tasks act on different variables, both require physical simulation, signal reconstruction, and scientific evaluation to assess candidate sequences.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究针对MRI序列研究中两个相关任务：序列设计与序列优化。 序列设计针对特定成像目标建立或修改射频、梯度、时序与读出事件的组织方式，并将所得方案转换为可执行的序列。 序列优化在物理约束下于定义好的参数或波形空间中进行搜索，以改善对比度、采集效率、信号特性或定量性能。 设计决定了可以探索哪些测量机制与序列结构，而优化则确定合适的运行条件。 尽管这两个任务作用于不同的变量，但二者都需要物理仿真、信号重建与科学评估来评价候选序列。

paragraphs.en: MRI sequence research has traditionally been coordinated by domain experts. Researchers develop protocols from physical principles and imaging requirements, write sequence programs, check the validity of gradient and RF events, inspect signals through Bloch simulations or scanner experiments, and repeatedly revise their designs based on reconstructed images and quantitative measures. This process requires combined expertise in pulse sequences, magnetization dynamics, computational models, and experimental conditions. A change in sequence structure or parameters may alter event timing, physical response, and reconstruction performance simultaneously, requiring renewed verification. The translation of research goals into specifications, integration of simulation and optimization tools, interpretation of evaluation results, and choice of subsequent revisions often remain manual. As the number of variables and constraints increases, cross-stage coordination and repeated computation become substantial components of research cost.
paragraphs.zh: MRI序列研究传统上由领域专家统筹协调。 研究者依据物理原理和成像需求制定协议，编写序列程序，检查梯度事件和射频事件的有效性，通过Bloch仿真或扫描仪实验观察信号，并根据重建图像和定量指标反复修改设计。 这一过程需要融合脉冲序列、磁化动力学、计算模型和实验条件等多方面的专业知识。 序列结构或参数的变更可能同时改变事件时序、物理响应和重建性能，因而需要重新验证。 将研究目标转化为规格说明、整合仿真与优化工具、解读评估结果以及选择后续修改方案，这些环节往往仍需人工完成。 随着变量和约束数量的增加，跨阶段的协调与重复计算成为研究成本的重要组成部分。

paragraphs.en: Computational tools have gradually changed this process. Numerical MRI simulators and portable sequence representations make candidate protocols easier to execute and compare, enabling some physical checks before scanner experiments [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . Magnetic resonance fingerprinting (MRF), introduced in 2013, demonstrated the role of acquisition timing in encoding quantitative information [ 8 ] . Subsequent optimal experimental design based on the Cramér–Rao lower bound (CRLB) linked spin dynamics to parameter-estimation precision [ 9 ] . In the 2020s, differentiable MRI simulators and automatic differentiation allowed sequence events and RF and gradient waveforms to be optimized for specified objectives [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] . Derivative-free methods have also used measured scanner feedback to explore imaging contrast automatically [ 13 ] . These studies have shifted candidate generation and parts of evaluation from manual trial and error toward automated computation. A complete research task, however, still requires objective interpretation, methodological choices, integration of tools, and adaptation of the research strategy to experimental feedback.

paragraphs.en: These requirements create an opportunity for AI agents in MRI sequence research. Unlike algorithms devoted to solving a predefined optimization problem, an agent can coordinate multiple steps around a research objective, invoke sequence construction, physical simulation, numerical search, and evaluation tools, and decide what to do next based on obtained results. Tool use and feedback-driven decisions have been investigated systematically in approaches such as ReAct [ 14 ] , while Coscientist illustrated the potential of language models for scientific experiment planning and tool coordination [ 15 ] . In MRI, GPT4MR explored language-model assistance for sequence and reconstruction programming [ 16 ] . The 2026 arXiv preprint Agent4MR further combined executable sequence code, physical verification, and simulation feedback for automated development and refinement [ 17 ] . Together, these developments show that agents can participate in program generation and iterative decisions in sequence research and motivate the integration of autonomous decisions with reliable physical computation, numerical optimization, and scientific evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 这些需求为MRI序列研究中的智能体创造了机会。 与专注于求解预定义优化问题的算法不同，智能体可以围绕研究目标协调多个步骤，调用序列构建、物理仿真、数值搜索和评估工具，并根据已获得的结果决定下一步做什么。 ReAct [14] 等方法系统地研究了工具使用和基于反馈的决策，而 Coscientist 则展示了语言模型在科学实验规划和工具协调方面的潜力 [15]。 在MRI领域，GPT4MR 探索了语言模型对序列和重建编程的辅助作用 [16]。 2026年的arXiv预印本 Agent4MR 进一步将可执行的序列代码、物理验证和仿真反馈结合起来，用于自动化开发与改进 [17]。 总的来说，这些进展表明智能体可以参与序列研究中的程序生成和迭代决策，并促使人们将自主决策与可靠的物理计算、数值优化和科学评估相结合。

sents.en: Unlike algorithms devoted to solving a predefined optimization problem, an agent can coordinate multiple steps around a research objective, invoke sequence construction, physical simulation, numerical search, and evaluation tools, and decide what to do next based on obtained results.
sents.zh: 与专注于求解预定义优化问题的算法不同，智能体可以围绕研究目标协调多个步骤，调用序列构建、物理仿真、数值搜索和评估工具，并根据已获得的结果决定下一步做什么。

sents.en: Tool use and feedback-driven decisions have been investigated systematically in approaches such as ReAct [ 14 ] , while Coscientist illustrated the potential of language models for scientific experiment planning and tool coordination [ 15 ] .
sents.zh: ReAct [14] 等方法系统地研究了工具使用和基于反馈的决策，而 Coscientist 则展示了语言模型在科学实验规划和工具协调方面的潜力 [15]。

sents.en: In MRI, GPT4MR explored language-model assistance for sequence and reconstruction programming [ 16 ] .
sents.zh: 在MRI领域，GPT4MR 探索了语言模型对序列和重建编程的辅助作用 [16]。

sents.en: The 2026 arXiv preprint Agent4MR further combined executable sequence code, physical verification, and simulation feedback for automated development and refinement [ 17 ] .
sents.zh: 2026年的arXiv预印本 Agent4MR 进一步将可执行的序列代码、物理验证和仿真反馈结合起来，用于自动化开发与改进 [17]。

sents.en: Together, these developments show that agents can participate in program generation and iterative decisions in sequence research and motivate the integration of autonomous decisions with reliable physical computation, numerical optimization, and scientific evaluation.
sents.zh: 总的来说，这些进展表明智能体可以参与序列研究中的程序生成和迭代决策，并促使人们将自主决策与可靠的物理计算、数值优化和科学评估相结合。

paragraphs.en: The central challenge in fully automated sequence research is to establish a continuous process connecting research objectives, executable sequences, and scientific outcomes. Candidate generation is only one part of that process. Natural-language objectives must be converted into explicit design requirements, adjustable variables, and constraints. Candidate events must satisfy physical and timing requirements before expensive magnetization evolution and reconstruction calculations. Different research tasks require different performance measures, and multiobjective results need consistent evaluation criteria. An automated workflow must also use failure reports and quantitative feedback to determine when to revise structures, adjust parameters, continue computations, or select a final design. Flexible agent decisions therefore need to operate together with executable physical models and deterministic scientific evaluation throughout candidate generation, verification, and selection.
paragraphs.zh: 全自动序列研究的核心挑战在于建立一个连接研究目标、可执行序列与科学产出的连续过程。 候选生成只是该过程的一部分。 必须将自然语言目标转换为明确的设计要求、可调变量与约束条件。 候选事件必须先满足物理与时序要求，再进行昂贵的磁化演化与重建计算。 不同的研究任务需要不同的性能度量，多目标结果需要一致的评估标准。 自动化工作流还必须利用失败报告与定量反馈来决定何时修改结构、调整参数、继续计算或选定最终设计。 因此，在候选生成、验证与选择的整个过程中，灵活的智能体决策需要与可执行的物理模型以及确定性的科学评估协同运作。

paragraphs.en: We therefore propose SmartBloch-Agent, a fully automated framework for MRI sequence design and optimization. Given research objectives and required constraints, an agent manages task interpretation, research planning, tool coordination, and feedback-informed decisions. Sequence construction and numerical optimization tools generate candidates, while Bloch simulation, reconstruction, and scientific evaluation guide successive iterations. Our contributions are threefold. (1) Automated MRI sequence design connects research requirements to executable sequence construction, physical verification, and feedback-based revision. (2) Automated MRI sequence optimization combines agent decisions with numerical search and scientific metrics for iterative improvement based on physical feedback. (3) The SmartBloch simulation engine , developed in-house, accelerates Bloch magnetization evolution using CUDA parallel computing and provides internal physical computation for both tasks. Together, these components form an automated workflow from research objectives to sequence candidates, physical evidence, and study outcomes, with execution, acquisition, reconstruction, and evaluation configured for the sequence type and research objective.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们提出 SmartBloch-Agent，一个用于 MRI 序列设计与优化的全自动化框架。 给定研究目标和所需约束，智能体负责任务解读、研究规划、工具协调以及基于反馈的决策。 序列构建和数值优化工具生成候选序列，而 Bloch 仿真、重建和科学评估则引导后续迭代。 我们的贡献有三点。 (1) 自动化 MRI 序列设计将研究需求与可执行的序列构建、物理验证以及基于反馈的修改相连接。 (2) 自动化 MRI 序列优化将智能体决策与数值搜索和科学指标相结合，基于物理反馈进行迭代改进。 (3) 自主研发的 SmartBloch 仿真引擎利用 CUDA 并行计算加速 Bloch 磁化演化，并为上述两项任务提供内部物理计算。 这些组件共同构成了一个从研究目标到序列候选、物理证据和研究结果的自动化工作流程，其执行、采集、重建和评估均根据序列类型和研究目标进行配置。

paragraphs.en: Sequence development translates imaging objectives into RF, gradient, and readout events while respecting magnetization dynamics, hardware amplitude limits, and timing constraints. Shared sequence representations are an important means of reducing development effort. Pulseq stores events and timing in standalone files interpreted by the scanner, separating prototype development from vendor-specific programming environments [ 6 ] . Pulseq-GPI provides a visual programming environment integrated with simulation and reconstruction [ 18 ] , and PyPulseq brings sequence construction into Python workflows [ 19 ] . These tools support development and exchange through common event representations, with automation mainly at the representation and execution interfaces.
paragraphs.zh: 序列开发将成像目标转化为射频、梯度和读出事件，同时需满足磁化动力学、硬件幅度限制和时序约束。 共享的序列表示是减少开发工作量的一种重要手段。 Pulseq 将事件与时序存储在由扫描仪解释的独立文件中，从而将原型开发与各厂商专用的编程环境相分离 [ 6 ] 。 Pulseq-GPI 提供了与仿真和重建相集成的可视化编程环境 [ 18 ] ，而 PyPulseq 将序列构建引入 Python 工作流 [ 19 ] 。 这些工具通过通用的事件表示支持开发与交换，其自动化主要体现在表示和执行接口层面。

paragraphs.en: Automated generation extends computation to sequence events themselves. MRzero constructs an end-to-end mapping through differentiable magnetization evolution and reconstruction. It adjusts RF events, gradient moments, and delays for target images or parameter maps and validates generated sequences in phantom and in vivo measurements [ 10 ] . Its task-loss-driven search extends beyond manual tuning of an existing protocol. A separate approach uses language models to generate programs. GPT4MR assists sequence and reconstruction programming through domain-specific prompting and interactive feedback [ 16 ] . SeqGPT trains a generative model on pseudorandom sequences and reports the generation of simulatable sequence structures [ 20 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 自动化生成将计算延伸到序列事件本身。 MRzero 通过可微的磁化演化与重建构建端到端映射。 它针对目标图像或参数图调整射频事件、梯度矩和延迟，并在体模和体内测量中验证生成的序列 [ 10 ] 。 其以任务损失驱动的搜索超越了对现有方案的手动调优。 另一种方法利用语言模型来生成程序。 GPT4MR 通过领域特定的提示和交互式反馈辅助序列与重建编程 [ 16 ] 。 SeqGPT 在伪随机序列上训练生成式模型，并报告了可仿真序列结构的生成 [ 20 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Sequence optimization expresses imaging requirements as computational objectives and searches for parameters subject to acquisition constraints. By encoding tissue properties with varying acquisition patterns, MRF [ 8 ] motivated a shift from signal amplitude toward the design of quantitative information. Comparisons of optimization algorithms examined the effects of search strategies on acquisition protocols [ 21 ] . CRLB-based optimal experimental design connects spin dynamics, noise assumptions, and parameter-estimation uncertainty [ 9 ] . B-spline parameterization represents time-varying acquisition patterns with a small number of coefficients, reducing a high-dimensional design to a compact search [ 22 ] . Studies of encoding capacity and parameter-map error have examined noise propagation and aliasing, respectively, informing the selection of evaluation objectives [ 23 , 24 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 序列优化将成像需求表达为计算目标，并在采集约束条件下搜索参数。 通过以不同的采集模式对组织特性进行编码，MRF [ 8 ] 推动了从信号幅值向定量信息设计的转变。 对优化算法的比较研究了搜索策略对采集协议的影响 [ 21 ] 。 基于 CRLB 的最优实验设计将自旋动力学、噪声假设与参数估计不确定性联系起来 [ 9 ] 。 B 样条参数化用少量系数表示时变的采集模式，将高维设计简化为紧凑的搜索 [ 22 ] 。 关于编码容量和参数图误差的研究分别考察了噪声传播和混叠问题，为评估目标的选择提供了依据 [ 23 , 24 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Differentiable methods propagate gradients through physical models. MRzero jointly considers sequence events and reconstruction, allowing target-image error, scan time, and RF energy requirements to enter the same optimization process [ 10 ] . For finer waveform design, automatic differentiation supports joint optimization of RF and gradient waveforms for tailored three-dimensional excitation [ 11 ] . AutoCEST links saturation modules, spin dynamics, and deep reconstruction networks in a differentiable system, jointly learning acquisition protocols and molecular parameter estimates, with validation in phantoms and mouse brains [ 25 ] . paragraphs.en: Physical feedback can also come directly from a scanner. MR-double-zero uses derivative-free CMA-ES search and feedback based on the regression error between measured images and a target to adjust preparation-pulse parameters automatically in chemical-exchange contrast experiments [ 13 ] . An agent can select among tools, interpret evaluations, and coordinate subsequent iterations. SmartBloch-Agent retains the complementary roles of numerical search and physical evaluation and coordinates candidate generation and multiobjective selection at the workflow level.

paragraphs.en: The Bloch equations describe magnetization evolution under applied fields and relaxation [ 1 ] . Applying them to sequence research requires modeling event timing, spatial encoding, tissue distributions, and received signals rather than relying solely on simplified signal expressions. JEMRIS supports three-dimensional simulations through modular sequences and parallel computation, including multichannel transmission and reception, off-resonance, nonlinear gradients, and time-varying parameters [ 5 ] . Such event-level simulation links candidate events to reconstructed data while making computational cost dependent on tissue sampling and model complexity.
paragraphs.zh: Bloch 方程描述了外加场和弛豫作用下磁化强度的演化 [ 1 ]。 将其应用于序列研究需要对事件时序、空间编码、组织分布和接收信号进行建模，而不能仅依赖简化的信号表达式。 JEMRIS 通过模块化序列和并行计算支持三维仿真，包括多通道发射与接收、离共振、非线性梯度以及时变参数 [ 5 ]。 这种事件级仿真将候选事件与重建数据联系起来，同时使计算成本取决于组织采样和模型复杂度。

paragraphs.en: GPU platforms exploit parallel spin evolution to increase simulation scale, although their modeling priorities differ. MRiLab incorporates a generalized multipool exchange model and uses GPU computation for exchange- and magnetization-transfer-related simulations [ 26 ] . BlochSolver executes experimentally compatible sequences, reproduces images through subvoxel sampling, and studies the effects of sampling density on artifacts and computational cost [ 27 ] . KomaMRI.jl provides CPU/GPU Bloch solvers, Pulseq-compatible input, and reconstruction interfaces in Julia [ 7 ] . paragraphs.en: Another approach to acceleration changes the representation of magnetization states. paragraphs.en: Agent4MR is the most directly related work in MRI. This preprint connects PyPulseq code generation and execution, timing and trajectory validation reports, and simulated-image feedback to support autonomous agent revisions. paragraphs.en: SmartBloch-Agent differs from Agent4MR primarily in its internal physical-computation capability and the organization of the end-to-end research process. Our framework integrates the GPU-accelerated SmartBloch Full-Bloch engine developed in this work, allowing magnetization evolution and signal calculations for candidate sequences to run internally. Without involving external MRI simulation software in iterative loops, the agent coordinates sequence construction, physical computation, result analysis, design revision, or parameter search according to the task. Structural design and parameter optimization share this internal physical-computation capability, while event execution, signal acquisition, reconstruction, and scientific evaluation are configured for the sequence type and objective. The framework brings executable sequence design files and their simulation, reconstruction, and evaluation results into an integrated research workflow. Table 1 compares representative approaches.
paragraphs.zh: SmartBloch-Agent 与 Agent4MR 的主要区别在于其内部物理计算能力以及端到端研究流程的组织方式。 我们的框架集成了本工作中开发的 GPU 加速的 SmartBloch 全布洛赫引擎，使得候选序列的磁化演化与信号计算能够在内部运行。 无需在迭代循环中引入外部 MRI 仿真软件，智能体即可根据任务协调序列构建、物理计算、结果分析、设计修订或参数搜索。 结构设计与参数优化共享这一内部物理计算能力，而事件执行、信号采集、重建和科学评估则根据序列类型和目标进行配置。 该框架将可执行的序列设计文件及其仿真、重建和评估结果纳入一个集成的研究工作流中。 表 1 对代表性方法进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: SmartBloch-Agent is an integrated framework for automated MRI sequence research, connecting natural-language research intentions to executable sequences, physical simulation, reconstruction-based evaluation, and final outputs. As shown in Fig. 1 , the agent interprets requirements, plans tasks, orchestrates tools, and chooses subsequent actions from feedback. A sequence construction module converts designs into executable events; a numerical optimization module searches specified design spaces; and physical computation and evaluation modules turn candidates into signals, images, and quantitative feedback. Task states and research artifacts connect these modules, reducing manual coordination during tool invocation, result transfer, and workflow handoffs.

paragraphs.en: The framework brings two related activities into a common process. Sequence design constructs and revises event composition, timing relationships, and acquisition strategies, whereas sequence optimization searches variables under performance objectives and constraints. These activities can address separate tasks or proceed together through design, evaluation, and refinement. For different objectives, task specifications, sequence representations, available tools, and evaluation criteria configure the research process, allowing physical evidence to inform distinct types of research actions.

paragraphs.en: The agent translates natural-language objectives into executable actions and updates its research strategy from task state, existing candidates, and evaluation feedback. In sequence design, actions include selecting or combining sequence components, modifying event dependencies, adjusting acquisition strategies, and correcting designs that violate constraints. In optimization, the agent orchestrates numerical search tools, interprets multiobjective results, and selects directions for further exploration. Its central role is research-level planning and cross-tool orchestration; specialized modules handle sequence construction, numerical search, Bloch evolution, reconstruction, and metric calculation. The agent is implemented with DeepSeek V4 Flash ( deepseek-v4-flash ) through an OpenAI-compatible function-calling interface with default API parameters; model configuration and record handling are described in Supplementary Section S7.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体将自然语言目标转化为可执行动作，并根据任务状态、已有候选方案和评估反馈更新其研究策略。 在序列设计中，动作包括选择或组合序列组件、修改事件依赖关系、调整采集策略，以及纠正违反约束的设计。 在优化中，该智能体调度数值搜索工具、解读多目标结果，并选择进一步探索的方向。 其核心作用是研究层面的规划与跨工具调度；专门的模块负责序列构建、数值搜索、Bloch演化、重建以及指标计算。 该智能体通过兼容 OpenAI 的函数调用接口，使用 DeepSeek V4 Flash（deepseek-v4-flash）并以默认 API 参数实现；模型配置与记录处理见补充章节 S7。

paragraphs.en: Research orchestration and scientific adjudication have distinct responsibilities. The agent can interpret feedback, invoke tools, and propose candidates, but its proposals cannot directly overwrite established physical results or evaluation rules. Evaluation modules enforce the scenarios, metric directions, and eligibility conditions in task contract 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , so candidates from different sources are assessed according to the task’s physical computations and selection criteria. Additional archived hybrid-search experiments record actual structured tool actions, rejected invalid parameters, and failed scientific eligibility checks; examples and record units are provided in Supplementary Sections S3 and S4.
paragraphs.zh: 研究编排与科学裁定具有各自不同的职责。 智能体可以解释反馈、调用工具并提出候选方案，但其提案不能直接覆盖既有的物理结果或评估规则。 评估模块强制执行任务契约 𝒯 \mathcal{T} 中的场景、指标方向和资格条件，因此来自不同来源的候选方案都依据该任务的物理计算和选择标准进行评估。 附加的归档混合搜索实验记录了实际的结构化工具操作、被拒绝的无效参数以及未通过的科学资格检查；示例和记录单元见补充章节 S3 和 S4。

paragraphs.en: Automated sequence design converts research requirements into executable pulse sequences that satisfy physical and acquisition constraints. The framework first interprets imaging objectives, desired signal or contrast characteristics, acquisition conditions, and resource requirements from natural language and organizes them into a structured design task. This task specifies both the intended scientific outcome and which parts of the sequence may be adjusted, together with the constraints they must satisfy, thereby linking research objectives to event construction and evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化序列设计将研究需求转换为满足物理与采集约束的可执行脉冲序列。 该框架首先从自然语言中解析成像目标、期望的信号或对比度特性、采集条件以及资源需求，并将它们组织为结构化的设计任务。 该任务既规定了预期的科学结果，也明确了序列中哪些部分可以被调整，以及它们必须满足的约束，从而将研究目标与事件构建和评估联系起来。

paragraphs.en: From the structured task, the agent selects design operations and proposes candidates. Sequence construction tools translate each candidate into explicit RF, gradient, sampling, and delay events and then check event relationships, timing consistency, hardware bounds, and acquisition layouts. The resulting event representation supports physical simulation and establishes a direct link between the executable sequence and subsequent research results. If structural, timing, or physical constraints are violated, the feedback identifies the affected events and reasons; the agent then coordinates revisions and repeats the checks.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体从结构化任务中选择设计操作并提出候选方案。 序列构建工具将每个候选方案转换为显式的射频、梯度、采样和延迟事件，然后检查事件关系、时序一致性、硬件边界和采集布局。 所得到的事件表示支持物理仿真，并在可执行序列与后续研究结果之间建立了直接联系。 如果违反了结构、时序或物理约束，反馈会指出受影响的事件及原因；智能体随后协调修订并重复检查。

paragraphs.en: Candidates that pass executability checks proceed to physical simulation and reconstruction. Scientific evaluation converts Bloch-derived signal evolution, acquisition data, and reconstructed images into contrast, signal-response, spatial-encoding, acquisition-efficiency, or other task-specific metrics. The agent uses these metrics and the research requirements to select subsequent design actions, such as revising event structures, changing sampling strategies, reconfiguring waveforms and timing, or optimizing parameters within an established structure. Physical feedback thus drives iterative sequence revision.
paragraphs.zh: 通过可执行性检查的候选方案将进入物理仿真与重建环节。 科学评估将由Bloch推导的信号演化、采集数据与重建图像转化为对比度、信号响应、空间编码、采集效率或其他任务特定的指标。 智能体利用这些指标和研究需求来选择后续的设计动作，例如修改事件结构、更改采样策略、重新配置波形与时序，或在既定结构内优化参数。 因此，物理反馈驱动序列的迭代修订。

paragraphs.en: Design outputs comprise executable sequences, event and acquisition descriptions, key design parameters, physical simulation results, reconstruction products, and scientific evaluations. These artifacts can be assembled into a sequence output package for a real-scanner workflow. Changes to individual candidates remain linked to their evaluations, providing both executable designs and evidence of their physical behavior and selection. Structural design and parameter refinement can alternate within a task, allowing the research process to proceed from intention to verifiable designs and deliverables without manually coordinating intermediate tool handoffs.
paragraphs.zh: 设计输出包括可执行序列、事件与采集描述、关键设计参数、物理仿真结果、重建产物以及科学评估。 这些产物可以组装成一个序列输出包，用于真实扫描仪的工作流程。 各个候选的变更始终保持与其评估的关联，既提供可执行的设计，也提供其物理行为与选择依据的证据。 结构设计与参数优化可以在同一任务内交替进行，使研究过程能够从意图推进到可验证的设计与交付物，而无需人工协调中间的工具交接。

paragraphs.en: Sequence optimization searches for better-performing protocols within a defined scientific objective and candidate space while keeping research requirements consistent. Variables may include continuous parameters of an existing design, discrete acquisition choices, waveform controls, or combinations thereof. The framework connects these variables and their valid ranges to executable sequence construction so that each candidate can be converted into event sequences and physically simulated using SmartBloch. Subsequent acquisition, reconstruction, and metric evaluation are configured for the research task.
paragraphs.zh: 序列优化在既定的科学目标和候选空间内搜索性能更好的序列方案，同时保持研究要求一致。 变量可以包括现有设计的连续参数、离散的采集选择、波形控制，或它们的组合。 该框架将这些变量及其有效取值范围与可执行的序列构建相连接，使得每个候选方案都能被转换为事件序列，并使用 SmartBloch 进行物理仿真。 后续的采集、重建和指标评估则根据研究任务进行配置。

paragraphs.en: The agent and numerical optimizers have complementary roles. Numerical algorithms search systematically within a specified variable space, whereas the agent uses interim metrics, trade-offs among candidates, constraints, and historical feedback to adjust subsequent actions. Multiobjective searches may use Optuna and NSGA-II to generate candidate sets [ 32 , 33 ] ; other strategies can be selected according to the search space and evaluation cost. Whether proposed by a language model, numerical search, or design revision, candidates undergo consistent executability checks and scientific evaluation to yield comparable outcomes. For flip-angle trajectories defined by a few control points, parameterization and interpolation expand low-dimensional candidates into complete waveforms across acquisition phases; constraints can be placed on changes between adjacent control points and adjacent phase-encoding steps separately.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体与数值优化器具有互补的角色。 数值算法在指定的变量空间内进行系统搜索，而智能体则利用中间指标、候选方案之间的权衡、约束条件以及历史反馈来调整后续行动。 多目标搜索可以使用 Optuna 和 NSGA-II 生成候选集 [32, 33]；其他策略可根据搜索空间和评估成本进行选择。 无论是语言模型提出、数值搜索生成还是设计修订得到的候选方案，都要经过一致的可执行性检查和科学评估，从而产生可比较的结果。 对于由少数控制点定义的翻转角轨迹，参数化和插值将低维候选方案扩展为覆盖整个采集阶段的完整波形；约束条件可以分别施加于相邻控制点之间以及相邻相位编码步之间的变化。

paragraphs.en: Here γ \gamma is the gyromagnetic ratio, and 𝐁 eff \mathbf{B}_{\mathrm{eff}} incorporates RF excitation, position-dependent gradient contributions, and local main-field off-resonance. Sequence events are expanded into ordered discrete evolution steps. At each substep, magnetization orientation is updated by the Rodrigues rotation formula and longitudinal and transverse relaxation by closed-form exponential expressions. paragraphs.en: Event execution, signal sampling, and reconstruction interface. The internal sequence builder and Pulseq import pathway organize RF excitation, free evolution, gradient encoding, and analog-to-digital converter (ADC) readouts into an event stream. paragraphs.en: GPU parallelism and runtime data organization. SmartBloch uses CUDA to distribute independent spin trajectories across GPU threads. The conventional path maps one thread to one spin, with each thread advancing its magnetization state through the full event stream. In the diffusion path, a thread block is assigned to each spin and cooperatively updates subspins and aggregates their contributions within the block. The anatomical flow-coupled path processes events in batches and retains spin states within each batch to reduce state transfers at event boundaries. For anatomical flow, preloaded four-dimensional velocity fields provide local velocities through spatial and temporal interpolation; spin positions are advanced by the midpoint method, with precomputed vessel-segment indices supporting position projection. These pathways share sequence-event and signal representations but employ distinct thread layouts and update strategies for ordinary evolution, diffusion, and flow workloads.

paragraphs.en: At the beginning of each simulation call, the required spin, event, sampling, and field data are transferred to the device. Magnetization evolution and signal accumulation then occur on the GPU throughout event execution, and outputs are returned to the host at completion. The conventional path accumulates k k -space signals through atomic operations. The anatomical flow path can alternatively store per-spin contributions and reduce them in a fixed order, yielding repeatable summation order at the cost of additional intermediate buffers. paragraphs.en: Research task and autonomous design. We evaluated SmartBloch-Agent’s ability to construct and revise executable sequences for imaging objectives using two-dimensional Cartesian fast spin echo (FSE). The task required a synthetic brain phantom to exhibit decreasing signal intensity from cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) to gray matter (GM) to white matter (WM), while satisfying scientific requirements including signal retention of at least 0.30 0.30 and scan time no longer than 320 320 s. A fixed BrainWeb digital brain phantom and tissue regions of interest were used, with an acquisition matrix of 256 × 256 256\times 256 . The agent proposed sequence structure and timing from the objective and then determined subsequent design actions using task-specific physical computation, acquisition, reconstruction, and scientific evaluation feedback.

Timing was fixed at T ​ R = 18 TR=18 ms and T ​ E = ( 3 , 6 , 9 , 12 , 15 ) TE=(3,6,9,12,15) ms, with reference trajectory α ref ​ ( p ) = 15 ∘ + 0.06 ∘ ​ p \alpha_{\mathrm{ref}}(p)=15^{\circ}+0.06^{\circ}p ( p = 0 , … , 255 p=0,\ldots,255 ). paragraphs.en: Stage 1: Combined six-parameter trade-off. Of 191 191 fully evaluated, deduplicated candidates, 58 58 met the predefined scientific eligibility criteria. Under multiobjective preference ranking within this eligible set, language-model proposal #353 was selected as the overall candidate. paragraphs.en: Research coordination efficiency. The SSFP-MOLED optimization involved 1,135 1{,}135 evaluation scenarios across three fidelity stages. High-fidelity physical evaluation dominated the computational workload, with the F2 stage accounting for 296.63 296.63 h of the total recorded execution time of 298.71 298.71 h. To characterize research-level efficiency, coordination costs were considered separately from physical computation. As summarized in Table 5 , SmartBloch-Agent autonomously coordinated candidate generation, scientific evaluation, feedback interpretation, and final selection without manual scientific-parameter editing. The coordination budgets for fixed and manually coordinated workflows were approximately 10 10 and 36 36 h per study, respectively. The comparison highlights the contribution of autonomous research orchestration to reducing human involvement in computationally intensive, multiobjective MRI sequence optimization.

paragraphs.en: The FSE design study makes this connection concrete. Across successive revisions, the agent adjusted repetition time, echo spacing, and the acquisition location of the central phase-encoding line, progressing from the initial candidate to an executable design meeting the specified objectives. Scan time decreased from 160 160 s to 96 96 s, while both CSF/GM and GM/WM contrast increased. Physical feedback directly informed choices about event timing and acquisition organization. The subsequent phase-encoding comparison revealed another aspect of sequence design: magnetization history and signal modulation across echoes affect spatial reconstruction through the assignment of k k -space lines. Replacing periodic interleaving with contiguous bands and changing the central-line acquisition location substantially reduced repeated structures in the reconstruction. The fraction of squared-magnitude energy outside tissue support decreased from 1.40180 % 1.40180\% to 0.04083 % 0.04083\% . CSF/GM contrast increased, however, while GM/WM contrast decreased, indicating that improved spatial consistency and preservation of a particular tissue contrast are distinct objectives. This trade-off motivates joint consideration of signal contrast, acquisition layout, and reconstruction quality in sequence design.

paragraphs.en: The SSFP-MOLED study addressed two successive questions. First, a six-parameter trade-off was evaluated under fixed scientific eligibility requirements; the selected candidate #353 improved five of six local standard-deviation-bound proxies. Next, candidate #186 was selected from the same archive for its T 2 T_{2} -specific metric and assessed in downstream quantitative reconstruction using paired synthetic data and separately trained reconstruction networks. Its T 2 T_{2} standard-deviation-bound proxy decreased by 45.33 % 45.33\% , and mean MAE across 64 64 test samples decreased by 8.69 % 8.69\% . This reflects the combined performance of the acquisition encoding and its matched reconstructor. The sum of squared flip angles was 4.124 4.124 times that of the reference, indicating a trade-off between quantitative accuracy and an RF energy proxy. Additional GRE and SE tasks illustrate how the same research orchestration accommodates other parameterized sequence problems.

paragraphs.en: Together, the experiments show that automatic sequence design and optimization address different levels of research variables but can be coordinated by an agent within a single framework. Design establishes measurement protocols at the level of events and acquisition structure; optimization searches for suitable operating conditions in a performance space. The SmartBloch Full-Bloch engine supplies internal physical computation for both, while execution, acquisition, reconstruction, and evaluation are configured by sequence and objective. We verified numerical consistency of the SmartBloch CUDA engine against an independent double-precision reference under the tested single-voxel conditions and reported runtime comparisons with other simulators for specified GRE-family tests. Current experiments primarily use two-dimensional numerical acquisitions and synthetic phantoms. Further assessments of simulation accuracy and throughput over broader sequences, complete imaging conditions, and controlled computational loads would help extend this automated research approach.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，实验表明自动序列设计与优化针对不同层次的研究变量，但可以在单一框架内由智能体加以协调。 设计在事件与采集结构层面建立测量协议；优化在性能空间中搜索合适的运行条件。 SmartBloch 全Bloch 引擎为两者提供内部物理计算，而执行、采集、重建和评估则由序列与目标来配置。 在所测试的单体素条件下，我们验证了 SmartBloch CUDA 引擎与独立双精度参考的数值一致性，并针对指定的 GRE 系列测试报告了与其他模拟器的运行时间比较。 当前实验主要使用二维数值采集和合成体模。 在更广泛的序列、完整成像条件和受控计算负载下，对模拟精度和吞吐量做进一步评估，将有助于扩展这一自动化研究方法。

paragraphs.en: We presented SmartBloch-Agent, an integrated framework that combines natural-language objective interpretation, research-level planning, sequence design, numerical optimization, Bloch simulation, reconstruction-based evaluation, and result packaging for MRI sequence research. The agent plans and orchestrates the research process, while numerical optimizers and the physical engine perform parameter search and computation, respectively. Task-specific execution and evaluation feed results back to the agent. In FSE design, the framework progressed from research objectives to executable event structures through proposals, feedback-driven revisions, and native acquisition, reducing manual workflow coordination. The SSFP-MOLED study first assessed six-parameter trade-offs and then selected a T 2 T_{2} -specific candidate, reducing mean absolute error in quantitative reconstruction by 8.69 % 8.69\% across 64 64 paired synthetic test cases. Autonomous orchestration integrated research decisions and physical evaluation throughout the computationally intensive optimization process without manual scientific-parameter editing. Local numerical comparisons between SmartBloch and an independent double-precision Bloch reference satisfied prescribed tolerances. The framework places the research path from natural-language objectives to executable sequences, physical evidence, and deliverable outputs under unified orchestration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SmartBloch-Agent，这是一个集成框架，将自然语言目标解读、科研级规划、序列设计、数值优化、Bloch 仿真、基于重建的评估以及结果打包整合用于磁共振成像（MRI）序列研究。 智能体负责规划并统筹研究流程，而数值优化器与物理引擎则分别执行参数搜索与计算。 针对具体任务的执行与评估将结果反馈给智能体。 在 FSE 设计中，该框架通过提案、基于反馈的修订以及原生采集，从研究目标推进到可执行的事件结构，减少了人工流程协调。 在 SSFP-MOLED 研究中，我们首先评估了六参数之间的权衡，随后选定了一个针对 T 2 T_{2} 的候选序列，在 64 64 组成对合成测试用例中，将定量重建的平均绝对误差降低了 8.69 % 8.69\%。 在整个计算密集型的优化过程中，自主统筹将研究决策与物理评估整合在一起，无需人工编辑科学参数。 SmartBloch 与独立的双精度 Bloch 参考实现之间的本地数值比较满足了预设的容差要求。 该框架将从自然语言目标到可执行序列、物理证据以及可交付成果的研究路径置于统一的统筹管理之下。

sents.en: Task-specific execution and evaluation feed results back to the agent.
sents.zh: 针对具体任务的执行与评估将结果反馈给智能体。

sents.en: In FSE design, the framework progressed from research objectives to executable event structures through proposals, feedback-driven revisions, and native acquisition, reducing manual workflow coordination.
sents.zh: 在 FSE 设计中，该框架通过提案、基于反馈的修订以及原生采集，从研究目标推进到可执行的事件结构，减少了人工流程协调。

sents.en: The SSFP-MOLED study first assessed six-parameter trade-offs and then selected a T 2 T_{2} -specific candidate, reducing mean absolute error in quantitative reconstruction by 8.69 % 8.69\% across 64 64 paired synthetic test cases.
sents.zh: 在 SSFP-MOLED 研究中，我们首先评估了六参数之间的权衡，随后选定了一个针对 T 2 T_{2} 的候选序列，在 64 64 组成对合成测试用例中，将定量重建的平均绝对误差降低了 8.69 % 8.69\%。

sents.en: Autonomous orchestration integrated research decisions and physical evaluation throughout the computationally intensive optimization process without manual scientific-parameter editing.
sents.zh: 在整个计算密集型的优化过程中，自主统筹将研究决策与物理评估整合在一起，无需人工编辑科学参数。

sents.en: Local numerical comparisons between SmartBloch and an independent double-precision Bloch reference satisfied prescribed tolerances.
sents.zh: SmartBloch 与独立的双精度 Bloch 参考实现之间的本地数值比较满足了预设的容差要求。

sents.en: The framework places the research path from natural-language objectives to executable sequences, physical evidence, and deliverable outputs under unified orchestration.
sents.zh: 该框架将从自然语言目标到可执行序列、物理证据以及可交付成果的研究路径置于统一的统筹管理之下。

paragraphs.en: This supplement provides numerical definitions, candidate-search archives, repeated design experiments, and additional validation supporting the methods and results in the main paper. GRE/SE extension tasks have separate research settings. The two SSFP-MOLED candidates serve different selection criteria and subsequent evaluation purposes.

paragraphs.en: The archive contained 691 691 search identifiers, including 180 180 LLM-generated and 511 511 numerical-search records. Of these, 474 474 were rejected before Bloch evaluation, 212 212 reached a post-Bloch terminal state, and 5 5 remained unfinished. Recovery and deduplication produced 194 194 candidate sequences, of which 191 191 had complete evaluations. paragraphs.en: An offline one-factor-at-a-time analysis of the same 191 191 complete candidates examined selection sensitivity. paragraphs.en: GRE and SE each used three random seeds (11, 23, 37) and two predefined configurations: numerical-only search (N) and agent-assisted without retrieval augmentation (A). Both task families evaluated worst-case two-tissue region-of-interest (ROI) contrast together with total acquisition time including preparation, using family-specific timing and scientific checks. Each task used staged evaluations of 16 candidates at 16 2 16^{2} , 4 at 32 2 32^{2} , and 1 at 64 2 64^{2} resolution (with five scenarios in each of the latter two stages), followed by a five-scenario replay of the selected candidate.

paragraphs.en: The additional automated FSE design tests covered four predefined objectives: tissue contrast (FSE-A), scan time (FSE-B), RF resources (FSE-C), and spatial leakage (FSE-D). Three independent tasks were scheduled for each. All 12 12 planned tasks produced scientifically eligible designs that passed independent replay. Including three original interruptions due to GPU occupancy, there were 15 15 launch attempts and 12 12 completions. Environment recovery followed a prespecified supplementary protocol that retained the original scientific thresholds and created new state records. First-candidate compilation succeeded in 11 / 12 11/12 tasks; 12 12 of 15 15 search candidates completing native evaluation were scientifically eligible. All three tasks requiring scientific-feedback revisions produced eligible designs. Exactly 7 / 15 7/15 launch attempts completed without initial environment repair or resource recovery. End-to-end times combine task records from two GPU platforms.

paragraphs.en: After parameter validation, Pulseq compilation, native Full-Bloch computation, acquisition reconstruction, and fixed scientific eligibility checks, FSE candidates advance to the next iteration based on actual feedback; numerical-search fallback is not used. For SSFP-MOLED, the agent interprets stage results and changes exploration direction, while numerical optimizers generate candidates. Only candidates passing execution checks and scientific eligibility enter Pareto comparison. Both task types stop when budgets are exhausted, no eligible candidate is found, or resource-management conditions terminate execution; final candidates must pass independent replay. Malformed or empty model responses are retried within the model budget. Unknown tools, invalid parameters, and out-of-bounds proposals are rejected, with compilation failures and scientific ineligibility recorded separately.

sents.zh: 每个网络仅在其对应序列生成的复杂观测上进行训练，且仅根据验证集 MAE 选择检查点。

sents.en: The test set was reserved for final evaluation.
sents.zh: 测试集保留用于最终评估。

sents.en: Results and paired distributions are reported in the main paper’s paired reconstruction table and Supplementary Section S5.
sents.zh: 结果与成对分布报告于正文的成对重建表格以及补充材料第 S5 节。

paragraphs.en: The final FSE design output package contains the following files:
paragraphs.zh: 最终的 FSE 设计输出包包含以下文件：

paragraphs.en: final_optimized_sequence.seq : executable sequence file;
paragraphs.zh: final_optimized_sequence.seq：可执行序列文件；

paragraphs.en: final_sequence_spec.json : complete event, timing, and key design parameters;
paragraphs.zh: final_sequence_spec.json：完整的事件、时序与关键设计参数；

paragraphs.en: final_optimized_config.json : final runtime configuration;
paragraphs.zh: final_optimized_config.json：最终运行时配置；

paragraphs.en: evidence_bundle.json : final candidate, independent replay results, and file SHA-256 hashes.
paragraphs.zh: evidence_bundle.json：最终候选结果、独立重放结果以及文件的 SHA-256 哈希值。

paragraphs.en: The task directory also stores task and scientific contracts, candidate lineage, LLM decision records, timing and event lists, complex samples, reconstructed images, scientific metrics, execution logs, and hardware execution information.
paragraphs.zh: 任务目录还存储任务与科学契约、候选谱系、LLM 决策记录、时序与事件列表、复杂样本、重建图像、科学指标、执行日志以及硬件执行信息。

paragraphs.en: Native SSFP-MOLED outputs include complex k k -space, complex reconstructions, magnitude and phase images, and readout trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: Native SSFP-MOLED 的输出包括复数 k 空间数据、复数重建结果、幅值图像和相位图像，以及读出轨迹。

paragraphs.en: The metric file is native_metrics.json ; the file manifest records data shapes, types, axis definitions, units, and hashes.
paragraphs.zh: 指标文件是 native_metrics.json；文件清单记录了数据的形状、类型、轴定义、单位和哈希值。

paragraphs.en: Pulseq sequence files can be included as exchange files in the output package. Actual scanner acquisition requires a corresponding Pulseq interpreter, vendor-specific sequence environment, and on-site hardware safety checks.
paragraphs.zh: Pulseq 序列文件可以作为交换文件包含在输出包中。 实际的扫描仪采集需要相应的 Pulseq 解释器、特定厂商的序列环境，以及现场硬件安全检查。
